background: per-channel temporal median of 23 actual frames per segment
vehicle_pixels: unwarped source RGB, alpha composited over temporal-median background; 3px feathered mask edge
opacity_rule: linear in elapsed time, 1.00 at first source time to 0.35 at last source time
selection_rule: mandatory elapsed 0 and 70.5; approximate spatial spacing 0.65 times median robot bounding-box geometric mean; selected poses are actual source frames
segmentation: difference threshold29, morphology open3 close17 dilation11
trajectory_overlay: vehicle-mask centroid sampled every 0.25 s from the same physical video segment; before=#F40506, after=#0503F2, opacity=0.60
